messages:
Alex J: Hey folks — pinging for eyes on PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6129. It's a prefetch eviction change to reduce KV spill for short sequences. Need runtime + infra + sec approvals before merge window. Can @Sam R, @Kavita P, @Maria C take a look? TL;DR: changed eviction threshold, added safety toggle, added unit + integration tests.

Sam R: On it. Quick question: did you run the long-tail perf harness? Results?

Alex J: Yes — local harness + canary run on staging. Latency regressed ~0.2% p50, tail improved ~6% p99. I pasted harness output below:
```
p50: 12.4ms -> 12.43ms
p99: 98.1ms -> 92.3ms
```
Also added config toggle `runtime.eviction.prefetch.enabled=false` for canary.

infra-jenkins-bot: CI passed — all checks green: unit, integration, e2e-staging. Deploy preview: https://staging.redwood-inference/changes/6129

Maria C: Skimming now. Two security q's: (1) Any change to cache key derivation? (2) Does toggle expose any new debug endpoint? If no to both I can LGTM. If yes, need a small design note.

Alex J: No changes to cache key derivation. Toggle is config-only, no new endpoints. I'll add a short design note to PR.

Kavita P: I can own canary. Are you planning a linear rollout? We should keep a rollback playbook. Also double-check GPU memory pressure tests — could increase evictions under high concurrency.

Alex J: Plan is 10% -> 30% -> 100% over ~4 hours, watch p99/p95 and evictions/sec metric. I'll add rollback steps and the memory pressure test results to the PR this afternoon.

Sam R: Left 1 nit (inline). Overall looks good to me after Maria signs off. @Kavita if you want me to pair on the canary ramp let me know.

Alex J: :thumbsup: Thanks! I'll update PR and ping again once design note + rollback steps are added.
